find: const layout: MarkLayout = isNarrowViewport() ? narrowMarkLayout(slots, total) : { kind: 'full' };
why: Issue #1021's whole change, cut at the seam: the measured table in stock-cue.ts is correct and pinned, but the `marks` builder never consults it, so a phone draws every mark at full size and four players at four or five stocks clips the last entry off the screen -- the silent overflow #835 measured for pips. stock-cue.test.ts stays green, because the rule itself is untouched; only the HUD cases driven through the narrow-viewport seam can see it.
